sources.entry: OpenMediaVault - Network attached storage (NAS) solution based on Debian Linux. It contains services like SSH, (S)FTP, SMB/CIFS, DAAP media server, RSync, BitTorrent client and many more. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: openmediavault is a Debian-based network attached storage (NAS) solution that bundles file-sharing and server services and can be extended with plugins.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes openmediavault as a NAS operating layer built on Debian Linux, offering services such as SSH, (S)FTP, SMB/CIFS and rsync. Its framework is modular, so functionality can be added through plugins. It is aimed at home and small office users and is presented as an out-of-the-box system for administering a NAS without deep Linux knowledge. Installation is described as a script run on an existing Debian system as root, with fuller instructions in the official documentation. The README links to documentation, a forum and a blog. The awesome-selfhosted listing also mentions a DAAP media server and a BitTorrent client; the README itself does not name these.
use_cases: turn a spare computer into a home NAS
share files over SMB/CIFS with a home network
serve files via SFTP or FTP
rsync backups to a home server
how_to_run: Install Debian on the target system
Run as root: wget -O - <install script URL> | sh -  (URL is not given in the README text provided)
Follow the official openmediavault documentation for detailed installation steps
notable: Built on Debian Linux with a modular plugin framework
Bundles SSH, (S)FTP, SMB/CIFS and rsync services
Designed for easy administration without deep Linux knowledge
Takes full control of OS configuration, so it is not run in a container
caveats: Expects full, exclusive control over OS configuration and cannot be used within a container
No graphical desktop environment can be installed alongside it
Installation is done on an existing Debian system; detailed steps are in external documentation
